title: Check your eligibility for Rentstart assistance
summary: Find out if you are eligible for various types of financial assistance, including Rentstart Bond Loan, Advance Rent, and others, to help with private rental housing in NSW.
intro: Rentstart provides financial assistance to eligible clients to help them set up or maintain a tenancy in the private rental market. There are 5 types of Rentstart assistance.
who_can_apply: Must be eligible for Rentstart assistance.
For Tenancy Assistance, you must have a rental agreement with the agent or landlord to continue the tenancy for up to 12 months, and this assistance is only available once in a 12-month period.
Rentstart Move assistance is for people who want to leave public housing or are no longer eligible for public housing or other Rentstart assistance.

more_info.text: Go to the Homes NSW website for more information including:

internal_links.text: Take a course on renting in NSW

faqs.a: Rentstart provides financial assistance to eligible clients to help them set up or maintain a tenancy in the private rental market.

faqs.q: What types of Rentstart assistance are available?
faqs.a: There are 5 types of Rentstart assistance available: Rentstart Bond Loan, Advance Rent, Rentstart Move, Tenancy Assistance, and Temporary Accommodation.

faqs.q: How is the Rentstart Bond Loan calculated?
faqs.a: The repayment plan period and fortnightly repayment amount are based on the Rentstart Bond Loan.
